title: Arithmetic-function mixed ratio inequality
outcome: The full source inequality holds for all n≥2 and k≥1, including actual totient, Dedekind psi and divisor-sum definitions.
novelty: Formal verification of Shivam Patel’s existing general proof; no first-proof or novelty claim.
shared_certificate: The paper and formal module jointly prove two distinct source questions, MathDB375256 and375257; each is counted once.
